name: How soon can I use my kitchen after it has been painted?

mainEntity.name: How soon can I use my kitchen after it has been painted?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can typically resume light kitchen use, such as accessing the refrigerator or making quick snacks, within 24 hours after the final coat dries, provided you avoid touching painted walls. However, full cure time takes two to four weeks depending on paint type and room ventilation. During this curing window, the paint film is still soft and susceptible to gouges, water stains, and grease penetration. Avoid scrubbing the walls or splashing hot liquids around painted surfaces until the paint has completely hardened.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can use the kitchen lightly after 24 hours, but paint takes two to four weeks to fully cure. Avoid scrubbing walls or splattering water until it completely hardens.
